rationale: The platform's described functions are real-time stream ingestion, curation, provenance tracking, edge monitoring, and deriving insights; no AI capability is stated.
evidence_spans:
ingests, curates, and analyzes data for key insights and immediate actionable intelligence. DataFlow addresses the following challenges:
Processing real-time data streaming at high volume and high scale
Tracking data provenance and lineage of streaming data
Managing and monitoring edge applications and streaming sources
